definitions.explanation: Musical instruments that originated in or are traditionally associated with Japan.

examples.japanese: {和楽器|わがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}いた→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I listened to a performance of traditional Japanese instruments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三味線|しゃみせん}→三味線：04464_shamisen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{和楽器|わがっき}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The shamisen is a representative Japanese instrument.

examples.japanese: {和楽器|わがっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}い→習う：00479_narau⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：18370_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started learning a traditional Japanese instrument.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{和|わ}→和〜：00418_wa⟧ (Japanese) + ⟦{楽器|がっき}→楽器：13159_gakki⟧ (musical instrument). Refers to instruments traditionally associated with Japanese music.

MAJOR INSTRUMENTS:
- ⟦{琴|こと}→琴：02152_koto⟧: koto (13-string zither)
- ⟦{三味線|しゃみせん}→三味線：04464_shamisen⟧: shamisen (3-string plucked instrument)
- ⟦{尺八|しゃくはち}→尺八：04465_shakuhachi⟧: shakuhachi (bamboo flute)
- ⟦{太鼓|たいこ}→太鼓：04049_taiko⟧: taiko (drum)
- ⟦{笙|しょう}→笙：noentry⟧: sho (mouth organ, used in ⟦{雅楽|ががく}→雅楽：27354_gagaku⟧)
- ⟦{篠笛|しのぶえ}→篠笛：28761_shinobue⟧: shinobue (transverse bamboo flute)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{洋楽器|ようがっき}→洋楽器：28762_yougakki⟧: Western instruments

USAGE:
Interest in {和楽器|わがっき} has grown in recent years, with fusion bands combining traditional instruments with rock and pop. The ⟦{和|わ}→和〜：00418_wa⟧〜 prefix pattern is productive: ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧ (Japanese food), ⟦{和服|わふく}→和服：04094_wafuku⟧ (Japanese clothing), ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧ (Japanese-style room).
